title: Apple and Apricot Oaty Crumble
description: A crumble of tinned apricots and apples with a lemon-zested oat topping, which can be frozen for later.

ingredients.text: the reduced-fat spread into the flour until it resembles breadcrumbs.

steps: Mix together the apples, apricots, white sweetener and lemon zest.
Place in an 18cm x 27cm (roughly 7in x 10½in) ovenproof dish.
Place the flour in a large bowl and add the reduced-fat spread. Rub the reduced-fat spread into the flour until it resembles breadcrumbs.
Stir in the oats, brown sweetener and cinnamon.
Spread the oat mixture over the apples and apricots and place the dish on a baking tray.
Place in the preheated oven and bake for 50–  55 minutes, until the fruit is tender and the topping is golden. (Or you can cool and freeze to have later.)
